entities.name: STK11 / LKB1
observations: The 440-aa query sequence is strongly homologous to reviewed STK11 proteins; human STK11 match is 81.5% identical over 98.9% query coverage.
STK11 is a serine/threonine kinase that activates AMPK-family kinases by T-loop phosphorylation; homolog annotations link it to energy metabolism, cell polarity, apoptosis, and DNA-damage responses.
Homolog annotations place STK11 in nucleus, cytoplasm/cytosol, membrane, mitochondrion, and late endosome; distribution can change with binding partners and cellular conditions.
Pfam detects a protein kinase domain at residues 51–308 in the query. Exact substrate repertoire is not established from homology alone.

entities.name: AMPK-family signaling
observations: STK11/LKB1 activates AMPK-family kinases, linking cellular energy status to growth control and metabolic adaptation, including autophagy under nutrient deprivation in reference annotations.
